title: Child sized spatulas
text: Child sized spatulas. Short handles, to the point of being almost useless. I'm not sure what these will work with besides getting residue out of soups cans, but the short handle makes that hard too.

product_metadata.title: Evelots Set of 6 Mini Silicone Spatula Set for Kitchen Cooking & Baking, Silicone Cooking Utensils Set, Heat Resistant BPA Free - Up To 446 Degrees
features: Slim Design: These 6 small spatulas are great to frost icing on a cupcake, whisk an egg, spread cheese, butter, or scrape containers. Also a good tool for using like a knife to get food, makeup, lotion, or other skincare and beauty product or paint out of a jar or can
Kitchen Utensil Essentials: The chef in your kitchen will find this silicone kitchen utensils set one of their favorite gadgets. Use them as a dough scraper, or like spoons to mix hot and cold food
Will Not Damage Dishes: Soft silicone tips won't scratch your glass, wood, bamboo bowls, copper or non-stick cookware or bakeware. Ideal for baking or preparing food on the stovetop or countertop

Easy Care: Spatulas are dishwasher safe and will not absorb stains and odors. Heat rated to 446 degrees, food grade silicone. Each spatula measures approximately 7 Inches long x 1 Inch wide x 0.5 Inch thick
From our Vermont home to yours: For over 10 years, Evelots has offered customers unique products with a 30-day easy return policy.
